title: Site Fact
description: v1 contract (task M5-T125, directive D-090 Wave 0; derived lane plan docs/lanes/PARALLEL_BUILD_PLAN.md section 5) for ONE site value of a study: lot area, frontage on one street, depth, lot type, zoning district, commercial overlay, street width, or existing ZONING floor area (plan docs/PRODUCT_PLAN_CURRENT_2026-09-28.md section 3 steps 3-4, section 4, section 9, task M1-07). A value is either (a) KNOWN - a number or text with its unit, one of five measurement ranks and a non-null source - or (b) UNKNOWN - value null, unit null, rank 'unknown', label 'Unknown — enter', and a non-empty 'blocks' list naming what it blocks (plan section 9: 'Unknowns stay unknown ... name what they block'). An unknown is NEVER encoded as 0: a known value must carry a source, and dimensions (lot area, frontage, depth, street width) must be strictly positive, so a bare 0 fails validation. The display label is tied to its rank (plan section 4 table), and each rank admits only the source kinds that can produce it. Existing zoning floor area may come only from a Buildings Department filing or certificate of occupancy, an architect entry, or a stated assumption - never from a city dataset such as PLUTO/DOF building area (plan section 3 step 4, section 8, task M2-07) - and it is strictly positive: a site without a building uses study option existing_building_plan 'no_existing_building', so a 0 can never silently make remaining capacity equal the full allowance. Coordinates never appear here (plan section 4).

contract_version.description: CLOSED enum of published site_fact contract versions. 1.0.0 = M5-T125 initial shape (D-090 Wave 0). New versions are admitted only by an accepted contract task that appends to this enum.

fact_id.description: Stable id of this fact within its study. Results list the fact ids they depend on (results.depends_on_fact_ids) so a change to this fact marks every dependent result out of date (plan section 9, dependency-based invalidation).

key.description: Which site value this is (plan section 3 step 3: lot area, frontage on each street, depth, lot type, zoning district(s), street widths; step 4: existing zoning floor area). CLOSED enum; new keys are added additively. A site with several districts or streets carries one fact per district or street.

lot_bbl.description: The tax lot this value belongs to, or null when it describes the whole selected site (a combined multi-lot value, plan section 4 'Multi-lot sites').

street.description: Street name for per-street values (lot_frontage and street_width REQUIRE it; plan section 3 step 3 'frontage on each street'); null for every other key.

value.description: The value: a number for areas and lengths, text for lot type, district and overlay; null ONLY when the rank is 'unknown'. Never NaN/Infinity (strict JSON).

unit.description: Unit of a numeric value: square_feet for areas, feet for lengths; null for text values and for unknowns.

source.description: Where the value came from (dataset, dataset version, retrieval or entry time, query or document reference). REQUIRED (non-null) for every known value; for an unknown it may name the source that was checked and returned nothing, or be null.

blocks.description: What this value blocks while it is unknown (plan section 9). Non-empty for rank 'unknown'; empty for every known value. For street_width the blocked outputs are not withheld: they are computed once per wide/narrow case and shown side by side, marked 'Needs street width' (plan section 4), each case a results document carrying results.street_width_case that names this fact.

editable.description: Whether the architect may edit this value on screen (plan section 3 step 3: 'Each shows its source and can be edited'). An edit becomes a new fact with rank 'entered' or 'survey_entered'; the city value is never overwritten in place.

note.description: Optional plain-English note for details (plan section 5a item 4). Never a substitute for the machine-readable fields.

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid fixture (packages/contracts README convention). Producers NEVER emit this key; it is allowed (optional) so an invalid fixture fails only for its stated defect under additionalProperties:false.

allOf.description: Rank rules: each rank admits only the source kinds that can produce it; every known rank needs a non-null value, a non-null source and an empty 'blocks' list; 'unknown' needs value null, unit null and a non-empty 'blocks' list.
Key rules: value type, unit and street per key. Dimensions are strictly positive (a 0 is never a real lot area, frontage, depth or street width, so it can only be an unknown in disguise).

measurement.description: Measurement rank and its display label, tied one-to-one (plan section 4 table and task M1-07). Labels for ranks 1-3 and 'unknown' are the plan's exact words; 'Entered' and 'Assumed' are the M1-07 status names (the plan gives no longer wording for them).

measurement_known.description: Any rank except 'unknown'. Results use it for the label of an answer's weakest input (plan section 4: 'Each result carries the label of its weakest input'); an answer whose weakest input is unknown is not available.

measurement_survey_entered.description: Rank 1: survey numbers the architect enters.

measurement_city_records.description: Rank 2: city-recorded dimensions and area (PLUTO, DOF), or a Buildings Department filing / certificate of occupancy for existing zoning floor area.

measurement_approximate_tax_map.description: Rank 3: computed from the city tax-map outline on the EPSG:2263 measurement path (never from an EPSG:4326 display outline).

measurement_entered.description: A value the architect typed that is not from a survey (task M1-07 'entered').

measurement_assumed.description: A stated assumption, shown as an assumption (plan section 9 'Explicit assumptions'; task M1-07 'assumed').

source.description: Where one value came from (lane plan section 5: 'its source, dataset version and date'). Every key is present; a key that does not apply is explicitly null, so absence is a visible statement. Per kind: city_dataset and tax_map_computation need dataset + query_ref; city_filing needs dataset + document_ref (job or certificate number); survey needs document_ref (the survey); assumption needs statement (the stated assumption). Synthetic/test sources use a clearly non-official dataset name (e.g. prefixed 'test-fixture-synthetic').

kind.description: PLATFORM-DEFINED source kind. survey = survey figures the architect enters; city_dataset = a city dataset record (PLUTO, DOF, DCP, City Map street data); city_filing = a Buildings Department filing or certificate of occupancy; tax_map_computation = computed from the DOF tax-map outline on the EPSG:2263 measurement path; architect_entry = a value the architect typed; assumption = a stated assumption.

dataset.description: Dataset or record family name (e.g. 'PLUTO', 'DOF Digital Tax Map', 'DOB NOW job filings'); null when not a dataset.

dataset_version.description: Dataset release identifier (e.g. PLUTO '26v2'); explicitly null when the source exposes none (DOF Digital Tax Map exposes none; see lot_geometry.schema.json).

retrieved_at.description: When the value was retrieved (city sources) or entered (architect, survey, assumption).

query_ref.description: The exact bounded query or request URL for a dataset retrieval (secrets never included); null otherwise.

document_ref.description: Document reference: DOB job or certificate-of-occupancy number, survey document id; null otherwise.

statement.description: The stated assumption in plain English (required for kind 'assumption'); null otherwise.

provenance_refs.description: OPTIONAL link to the full PRD section 9 provenance: the provenance_id values of the source_fact.schema.json records this value was normalized from. This source object is the display summary the architect sees; it never replaces the canonical source_fact record (packages/contracts README: no competing schemas).

blocked_output.description: An output an unknown value blocks: the three answers (plan section 5), remaining capacity after an existing building (section 3 step 4), the section 5b paths, the unit estimate (section 11b) and the drawing geometry (section 5c).
